scope_reference_evidence.text_excerpt: This attributional PCR covers one declared grade of virgin white fused alumina abrasive grain manufactured from whole supplied calcined alumina through electric-arc fusion, actual cooling/solidification and corundum crystallization, crushing, separation, screening/grading, any necessary evidenced physical cleaning/drying, inspection and unique first final quality release. Include receipt, internal transfers, controls, utilities, furnace/equipment service, all failures and zero-output runs, start/stop, idle, cleanup and pre-release rework. Packing, finished-grain storage, handling and dispatch are retained in a separate original-cohort service account. Buying finished grain and repacking does not implement this manufacturing boundary.

Natural corundum/emery; brown fused bauxite+coke+iron/ferrosilicon co-production; sintered/tabular/sol-gel alumina; zirconia-alumina and intentionally doped fusion routes; hollow alumina bubbles; gemstone or technical single-crystal sapphire; Bayer refinery alumina as finished reference; bonded whole wheels, coated abrasives, grinding spheres, complete refractory bricks and crucibles; used blasting-grain recycling and downstream use. Acid treatment or surface coating is not presumed; a real additional route needs renewed primary applicability and its separate whole formulation, utilities, emissions and wastes.

ALTEO supports the actual feed and electric-arc route; Washington Mills supports a commercial virgin white fused abrasive terminal and solidified-ingot-to-sized-grain manufacture. EPA supports generic grain processing with optional wet steps, while its bauxite/coke/iron fusion paragraph describes a different route. This is a transparent technical synthesis across sources, not one SKU, plant or current order. No universal purity, temperature, time, current, particle target, recipe, specific energy, electrode rate, yield, density, lifetime, abrasion performance or certification is prescribed. The multi-grade SDS does not reveal every impurity/minor phase; collect the whole actual grade, free moisture and size configuration. `alteo-white-fused-alumina`; `wm-fused-mineral-process`; `wm-duralum-special-white`; `wm-white-alumina-family`; `wm-white-alumina-sds-2025`; `epa-abrasive-manufacturing
